what: Results regenerated with the corrected simulation engine (same scenarios, same seeds as the published set).

physics_models.leo_slant_rain: gamma * h_rain / sin(el); no P.618 reduction factors
physics_models.orbit: circular, spherical Earth, no J2, no Earth rotation in pass timing
physics_models.rain_specific_attenuation: ITU-R P.838-3 analytic fit (1-100 GHz), pure H polarization, theta=0
physics_models.terrestrial_distance_factor: ITU-R P.530-18 form (P.530-19 not adopted; see docs/LIMITATIONS.md)

differences_vs_published: rain model: ITU-R P.838-3 analytic fit (published set: superseded P.838-0/-1 table)
data-quality gate: newly seen serving contexts learn a baseline from their first 20 valid samples
evidence-based VERIFY (serving-context aware, ATPC-masking aware); new columns first_action, verify_outcome_first, verified_first, verify_outcome_escalation, verified_escalation
new columns t_decision_layer_escalation and escalation_window_min (like-for-like window)
coverage_comparison.csv: two added LEO capacity-bound rows; microwave hop 18.32 -> 16.21 km
not_included: decision-layer parameters and scenario definitions are deliberately not part of this record

reproducibility.seeds: 1..30 for the sweep; 15 seeds per configuration for the sensitivity files
reproducibility.default_configuration_note: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys) of the default FeatureConfig, DecisionConfig and RunConfig objects of the private engine. It verifies the identity of that configuration artifact; it does not reproduce results without access to the engine. Scenario definitions are not covered by this hash.

environment_reproduction.python_3.13.16_numpy_2.5.4_pandas_3.0.6: runs.csv and summary.csv byte-identical to the published files (this record's original run)
environment_reproduction.python_3.12.3_numpy_2.5.4_pandas_3.0.6: full 330-run sweep regenerated 2026-10-12: runs.csv and summary.csv byte-identical (same SHA-256)
environment_reproduction.not_tested: Python 3.10 and 3.11 (CI covers 3.10-3.12 for the engine tests; the sweep outputs were not regenerated there); sensitivity_*.csv and coverage_comparison.csv were not regenerated on 3.12

reproducibility.figure_generation: python replot.py --data data/corrected --out figures/corrected ; python replot_dark.py --data data/corrected --out <dir> (article variants)

residual_trace: sensitivity_residual_trace.csv was produced from the corrected engine (58ce16a) by the engine's own diagnose_residual() on RESIDUAL_CASES (mw_rain_cell seed 10; leo_low_elevation seed 1), read-only. Same columns as the published data/sensitivity_residual_trace.csv. Added after the 1.1 data release; the six earlier file hashes are unchanged.
